description.value: Levantine is a Syrian Middle Eastern restaurant in Victoria dedicated to authentic cuisine, from shawarma and kebabs to traditional breakfast plates and freshly made pastries. The menu spans a wide range of dishes rooted in Syrian culinary heritage, making it a satisfying and distinctive stop for cyclists seeking a substantial meal. Warm hospitality and a focus on genuine flavours set it apart from generic Mediterranean spots.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website corroborates all OSM contact details (phone 250-590-0888, address 225 Menzies Street, Victoria) and shows an active Syrian Middle Eastern restaurant with a current, detailed menu. The menu page explicitly labels the Fresh Falafel wrap as 'vegan' and includes multiple falafel, salad, and pastry items suitable for plant-based diners. No cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi, charging, etc.) are mentioned anywhere on the website.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active, publicly accessible restaurant in Victoria with a confirmed website and a current detailed menu. A solid food stop for touring cyclists.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu explicitly labels Fresh Falafel wrap as 'vegan'; falafel platter, Fattoush salad, Tabbouleh salad, and Zaatar/Muhammara pastries are additional plant-based options

wow_evidence: Syrian Middle Eastern restaurant in Victoria dedicated to authentic cuisine
